rules.name: SQL Injection Attack against Web Portal
rules.title: SQL Injection Attack against Web Portal
rules.description: Detects SQL injection signatures against corporate web application endpoints
rules.yaml:
title: SQL Injection Attack against Web Portal
id: rule-sql-injection
status: enabled
severity: CRITICAL
description: Detects SQL injection signatures against corporate web application endpoints
logsource:
  category: web_server
  product: http
detection:
  selection:
    type: 'SQL_INJECTION_DETECTED'
  condition: selection

rules.name: ARP Poisoning / Spoofing Activity
rules.title: ARP Poisoning / Spoofing Activity
rules.description: Detects ARP poisoning attacks via arpspoof command or conflicting MAC hardware mappings
rules.yaml:
title: ARP Poisoning / Spoofing Activity
id: rule-arp-spoof
status: enabled
severity: CRITICAL
description: Detects ARP poisoning attacks via arpspoof command or conflicting MAC hardware mappings
logsource:
  category: network_security
  product: arp
detection:
  selection_cmd:
    metadata.command|contains: 'arpspoof'
  selection_conflict:
    type: 'ARP_REPLY'
    metadata.conflict: true
  condition: selection_cmd or selection_conflict

rules.name: Network Port Scanning Activity
rules.title: Network Port Scanning Activity
rules.description: Detects port scan reconnaissance tools such as nmap
rules.yaml:
title: Network Port Scanning Activity
id: rule-port-scan
status: enabled
severity: HIGH
description: Detects port scan reconnaissance tools such as nmap
logsource:
  category: reconnaissance
  product: network
detection:
  selection_tool:
    metadata.command|contains: 'nmap'
  condition: selection_tool

rules.name: SSH Authentication Brute Force Attack
rules.title: SSH Authentication Brute Force Attack
rules.description: Detects 3 or more failed SSH login attempts from the same IP within 30 seconds
rules.yaml:
title: SSH Authentication Brute Force Attack
id: rule-ssh-bruteforce
status: enabled
severity: HIGH
description: Detects 3 or more failed SSH login attempts from the same IP within 30 seconds
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: ssh
detection:
  selection:
    type: 'SSH_AUTH_FAILED'
  aggregation:
    operator: count
    threshold: 3
    timeframe: 30
    by: source
  condition: selection

rules.name: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
rules.title: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Detects direct switch to root user or privilege escalation via sudo su
rules.yaml:
title: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
id: rule-root-priv-esc
status: enabled
severity: CRITICAL
description: Detects direct switch to root user or privilege escalation via sudo su
logsource:
  category: privilege_escalation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_sudo_su:
    metadata.command|contains: 'sudo su'
  selection_su_root:
    metadata.command: 'su root'
  condition: selection_sudo_su or selection_su_root

rules.name: ICMP Reconnaissance Sweep
rules.title: ICMP Reconnaissance Sweep
rules.description: Detects host discovery via ping sweeps across multiple unique destination hosts
rules.yaml:
title: ICMP Reconnaissance Sweep
id: rule-icmp-sweep
status: enabled
severity: MEDIUM
description: Detects host discovery via ping sweeps across multiple unique destination hosts
logsource:
  category: network
  product: icmp
detection:
  selection:
    type: 'ICMP_ECHO_REQUEST_SENT'
  aggregation:
    operator: count
    distinct: destination
    threshold: 4
    timeframe: 20
    by: source
  condition: selection

rules.name: SSH Brute Force Attack
rules.title: SSH Brute Force Attack
rules.description: 3 or more SSH authentication failures from the same source within 60 seconds
rules.yaml:
id: rule-ssh-brute-force
title: SSH Brute Force Attack
description: 3 or more SSH authentication failures from the same source within 60 seconds
severity: CRITICAL
status: production
detection:
  selection:
    type: SSH_AUTH_FAILED
  aggregation:
    operator: ">="
    threshold: 3
    timeframe: 60s
    by: source
  condition: selection

rules.name: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
rules.title: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Direct root user interactive session or superuser privilege escalation detected
rules.yaml:
id: rule-root-login
title: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
description: Direct root user interactive session or superuser privilege escalation detected
severity: CRITICAL
status: production
detection:
  selection_su:
    type: COMMAND_EXECUTED
    command|contains:
      - "sudo su"
      - "sudo -i"
      - "su -"
      - "su root"
  selection_ssh_root:
    type: SSH_AUTH_SUCCESS
    metadata.user: root
  selection_root_event:
    type: ROOT_LOGIN
  condition: selection_su or selection_ssh_root or selection_root_event

rules.title: SSH Interactive Login

rules.yaml:
id: rule-ssh-success
title: SSH Interactive Login
description: Successful remote SSH authentication and interactive session opened
severity: LOW
status: production
detection:
  selection:
    type: SSH_AUTH_SUCCESS
  condition: selection

rules.name: Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
rules.title: Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
rules.description: Detects interactive shell execution spawned via netcat or ncat
rules.yaml:
id: rule-netcat-reverse-shell
title: Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
description: Detects interactive shell execution spawned via netcat or ncat
severity: CRITICAL
status: production
detection:
  selection_cmd:
    type: COMMAND_EXECUTED
    command|contains:
      - "nc "
      - "netcat"
      - "ncat"
    command|contains_all:
      - "-e"
  selection_netcat_sh:
    command|contains:
      - "nc -e"
      - "netcat -e"
      - "/bin/bash"
      - "/bin/sh"
  condition: selection_cmd or selection_netcat_sh
